activities.name: AssertLandscapeSystem
activities.remarks: Unresolved SapConfig. SystemId is looked up in the landscape catalog. SapLogonDescription is written back from the landscape name when found and not already set.

sections.title: Notes
sections.body: Unresolved SapConfig. SystemId is looked up in the landscape catalog. SapLogonDescription is written back from the landscape name when found and not already set.

sections.title: Inputs
sections.body:
- `io_Config`: `rs:SapConfig` - Unresolved SapConfig. SystemId is looked up in the landscape catalog. SapLogonDescription is written back from the landscape name when found and not already set.
- `out_IsKnown`: `x:Boolean` - True if io_Config.SystemId was found in the landscape, or if SystemId is empty (skipped).
- `out_Description`: `x:String` - SAP Logon display name for in_Config.SystemId. Empty when not found or skipped.
- `out_Status`: `scg:Dictionary(x:String, x:Object)` - Operational result. Keys (strip prefix): result (KNOWN|UNKNOWN|SKIPPED), isSuccess, systemId, description, isComplete.

activities.name: AssertSessionReady
activities.remarks: Resolved SAP session handle (connection and session index).

sections.title: Notes
sections.body: Resolved SAP session handle (connection and session index).

sections.title: Inputs
sections.body:
- `in_Session`: `rs:SapSession` - Resolved SAP session handle (connection and session index).
- `in_MaxAttempts`: `x:Int32` - Maximum session.Busy poll cycles before giving up. Default 3.
- `in_WaitIntervalSec`: `x:Int32` - Seconds between session.Busy polls. Default 3.

sections.title: Notes
sections.body: Resolved SAP session handle (connection and session index).

sections.title: Inputs
sections.body:
- `in_Session`: `rs:SapSession` - Resolved SAP session handle (connection and session index).
- `in_MaxDepth`: `x:Int32` - Maximum recursion depth per window. Default 10 — covers SAP's deepest observed tabstrip/subscreen nesting on master-data screens.
- `in_IncludeMenu`: `x:Boolean` - Include the menu bar subtree. Default False — menu is static/screen-independent noise for failure forensics.
- `out_Dump`: `x:String` - Dump of every currently open window (wnd[0], wnd[1], ...), one line per element.

activities.name: FlushLoginPopups
activities.remarks: Zero-based SAP connection index. Pass -1 (default) to handle all connections.

sections.title: Notes
sections.body: Zero-based SAP connection index. Pass -1 (default) to handle all connections.

sections.title: Inputs
sections.body:
- `in_Connection`: `x:Int32` - Zero-based SAP connection index. Pass -1 (default) to handle all connections.
- `in_Session`: `x:Int32` - Zero-based SAP session index within in_Connection. Pass -1 (default) to handle all sessions. Requires in_Connection >= 0.
- `in_IniPath`: `x:String` - Absolute path to post_login_popups.ini. Empty (default) = library-bundled scripts\SAP\post_login_popups.ini is used. Supply an absolute path to override with a consuming-process-specific ruleset.
- `out_Status`: `scg:Dictionary(x:String, x:Object)` - Operational status dict. Keys (strip prefix): result, isSuccess, connection, session, handled.
- `out_Result`: `scg:Dictionary(x:String, x:Object)` - Domain result dict. Keys (strip prefix): finalTx, finalTitle, type, rule, reason, policy, message, title, text.
- `out_Rows`: `sd:DataTable` - Full TSV result as DataTable — one row per SAP session processed.
- `in_LibraryRoot`: `x:String` - Root content folder of the library package (SapConfig.LibraryRoot). Used to locate flush_login_popups.vbs and the default post_login_popups.ini.

arguments.name: in_Connection
arguments.summary: Zero-based SAP connection index. Pass -1 (default) to handle all connections.
